# ruvllm/tests/fixtures

Static fixtures for integration tests.

## Files
- `mod.rs` - small helper that exposes fixture-loading utilities to tests.
- `test_prompts.json` - canonical prompt set used by generation and e2e
  tests.
- `perplexity_baselines.json` - reference perplexity values for
  cross-platform / quantization-equivalence assertions.
